name: HabanaAI/vllm-fork reached EOL at v1.23.0; vllm-gaudi plugin is the only supported path
symptom: The HabanaAI/vllm-fork repository reached end-of-life (EOL) at v1.23.0 and is deprecated in v1.24.0, remaining functional only for legacy use cases until then. The vllm-gaudi plugin is production-ready in v1.23.0 and becomes the default by v1.24.0.
root_cause: Intel migrated from a fork-based approach to a plugin-based architecture for vLLM on Gaudi. The plugin approach follows the vLLM hardware pluggable RFC and provides better maintainability.
workaround: Migrate to the vllm-gaudi plugin (https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-gaudi). The plugin is community-maintained by the Intel Gaudi team. Version 0.26.0 is built on vLLM 0.26.0 and compatible with Gaudi v1.24.1 and PyTorch 2.11.
notes: Anyone still using the HabanaAI/vllm-fork should migrate to the plugin. The fork is no longer receiving updates. The plugin supports all major models (Llama 3.1, Mistral, Mixtral, Qwen2.5, Qwen3, DeepSeek) and includes custom ops for MoE, FP8 quantization, and Mamba architectures.
